adjudication.rationale:
In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration unconditionally does:

`category_id = execute("SELECT c.id ... INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'].to_i`

Because it INNER JOINs on `s.value = c.name`, if `embed_category` is blank or doesn’t match any category name (which is plausible/likely for sites that never configured embedding), the query returns 0 rows and indexing `[0]` on the PG::Result raises (commonly IndexError), aborting the migration before the later fallback logic (`if category_id == 0 ...`). This would block upgrades for affected installs.
